description: Lays a colour over the panels of the modules in your rack, faded in and out by a button or a cable

params.text: Chooses whether the colour goes over the panel only, leaving the knobs and jacks clear, or over the whole module, in which case that module can no longer be used
Chooses whether the jack above it is read as a trigger that turns the toning on and off, or as a continuous level setting the strength of the colour
Sets how long the colour takes to fade in and to fade out, 0 to 10 seconds

inputs.text: A trigger here fades the colour in, and the next one fades it out; with the switch below set to Continuous the voltage sets the strength of the colour instead, 0-10V

notes: no panel is toned until the GO button is pressed, or F2 with the pointer over the module; press again to fade out
with the switch below the jack set to Continuous, the GO button has to be on before the voltage does anything, and the jack is then named Fade amount
which modules are toned is chosen in the hamburger menu at the top; the choice is remembered with the patch
the palette button opens a colour picker for the toning colour, and the transparency of that colour sets the strength: an opaque colour hides the panel altogether
the palette button is not a parameter, so no click on it reaches this help
the GO button and the lamp beside it are not parameters, so no click on them reaches this help
a Copper or Copper-mini on either side can set and animate the toning colour, with Use Copper color turned on here and Share color as Extender turned on in the Copper
the toning lays a widget the size of the panel over each module, which assumes a module is built the usual way; modules that draw their own panels may come out differently
toning shows best on dark panels
menu: Use Copper color — in the hamburger menu at the top: takes the toning colour from a Copper or Copper-mini standing beside this module
Tone this PanelTone — in the hamburger menu at the top: includes this module itself among the toned ones
All — in the hamburger menu at the top: tones every module in the rack
Selected modules — in the hamburger menu at the top: tones the modules that were selected when this was chosen, and keeps that list until it is chosen again
Modules in this row — in the hamburger menu at the top: tones every module in the same rack row as this one
Modules to the left — in the hamburger menu at the top: tones every module to the left in this row
Continuous modules to the left — in the hamburger menu at the top: tones the unbroken run of modules immediately to the left
Modules to the right — in the hamburger menu at the top: tones every module to the right in this row
Continuous modules to the right — in the hamburger menu at the top: tones the unbroken run of modules immediately to the right
Module to the left — in the hamburger menu at the top: tones the one module immediately to the left
Module to the right — in the hamburger menu at the top: tones the one module immediately to the right
